worldcombat.skill.aquaring.summary: A veil of water restores a small share of missing health while you move. It ends when its duration expires or the veil is cleared.
worldcombat.skill.aquaring.use.0: Give yourself a steady sustain line in a long fight
worldcombat.skill.aquaring.use.1: Heal while backing off and stretch the war of attrition
worldcombat.skill.aquaring.use.2: Open the veil stronger in the rain
worldcombat.skill.aquaring.description.0: The veil surges every %2$s, restoring %1$s of the health missing at that moment; higher Special Defence and heavier rain raise each surge.
worldcombat.skill.aquaring.description.1: The veil lasts %1$s, increasing with level and Special Defence.
worldcombat.skill.aquaring.description.2: It ends when its timer runs out or it is cleared, and it cannot be cast again while a veil is already up. You can move and act normally while it lasts.
worldcombat.skill.aquaring.spring.on: Spring: interval x0.65 and pulse x1.35 (faster, bigger), at the cost of veil duration x0.7.
worldcombat.skill.aquaring.spring.off: Trickle: baseline interval and pulse, veil duration x1.25 - slower but longer and steadier.
worldcombat.skill.aquaring.timing: A self move; after %1$s s of wind-up it spends %3$s PP, then recovers for %2$s s with a %4$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.aquaring.growth.0: At level %1$s the veil lasts up to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.aquaring.growth.1: At level %1$s the veil lasts further up to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.aquaring.preference.sp: Spring: interval x0.65, healing fraction x1.35 and duration x0.7. Trickle keeps the baseline healing rhythm with duration x1.25.
worldcombat.skill.aquaring.preference.ai: Below this health ratio the companion schedules Aqua Ring as sustain; lower prefers to keep attacking, higher opens the veil at the first wound.
